items.title: 16th BRICS Health Ministers Meeting
items.whyInNews: The 16th BRICS Health Ministers Meeting will be held in Chandigarh from July 22 to 24, 2026. The meeting will be attended by health ministers from Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa.
items.summary: The 16th BRICS Health Ministers Meeting will focus on discussing key health issues and challenges faced by the member countries. The meeting will be chaired by India's Health Minister. The BRICS nations will also discuss ways to strengthen cooperation in the health sector.

items.title: National Skill Qualification Framework
items.whyInNews: The National Council for Vocational Education and Training (NCVET) has recognized several institutions as awarding bodies under the National Skill Qualification Framework (NSQF).
